how.label: How it works
how.subtitle: No complex setup. No cloud account. Just install, record, and everything is processed right on your computer.
how.step1Desc: Record your microphone, system audio, and screen simultaneously. Compatible with Meet, Zoom, Teams, and any app.
how.step2Desc: Whisper AI processes audio on your PC. Identifies speakers, timestamps, and generates editable transcription instantly.
how.step3Desc: Copy the full context of any project to paste into Claude or ChatGPT. Or export as .md, .txt, or .zip.
how.step4Desc: Group meetings by client or project. Search across all transcriptions. The glossary extracts key terms.

features.label: Features
features.subtitle: No hidden telemetry, no weird dependencies, no bloatware. Just the features a professional needs to master their meetings.
features.f1Desc: Not a single word leaves your computer. No servers, no external API keys, no one reading your meetings. Whisper runs on your GPU or CPU.
features.f2Desc: Screen video with system audio and microphone on separate tracks. Per-channel transcription for better accuracy.
features.f3Desc: Assign names to each voice. Helpmeet learns who is who in each project.
features.f4Desc: Search across all transcriptions instantly. Find any decision in seconds.
features.f5Desc: Export a project's complete history -- meetings, decisions, participants -- in a block ready to paste into Claude or ChatGPT.
features.f6Desc: PDFs, DOCX, and presentations to .md with OCR.
features.f7Desc: Get on a plane, go to the countryside, lose your wifi. Helpmeet won't notice.

compare.label: Philosophy
compare.subtitle: Most transcription tools live in the cloud and charge every month. Helpmeet is local by design and a one-time purchase. We compare models, not brands.
compare.cloudSub: Most common approach in the market.
compare.cloud1: Audio is uploaded to external servers for processing.
compare.cloud2: Requires an active internet connection to work.
compare.cloud3: Recurring charges (monthly or annual) as long as you use it.
compare.cloud4: If you stop paying, you lose access to your transcriptions.
compare.cloud5: Data handling depends on the provider's policies.
compare.usSub: Full control of your data and your costs.
compare.us1: All processing happens on your own computer.
compare.us2: Works offline — even in airplane mode.
compare.us3: One payment. Perpetual license for the purchased version.
compare.us4: The app keeps working even if you don't renew.
compare.us5: Files and transcriptions stay on your hard drive.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitlePrefix: If you have any other questions, write to us at
faq.q1: Is everything really processed on my PC?
faq.a1: Yes. Helpmeet uses Whisper.cpp running locally. The app does not send audio, transcriptions, or metadata to any external server. You can disconnect your network while using it and it works perfectly.
faq.a2: Windows 10 or 11, 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB recommended), 2 GB free disk space. Any modern CPU works; a GPU speeds up transcription but is not required.
faq.q3: Can I transcribe in multiple languages?
faq.a3: Yes. Whisper detects the language automatically and supports over 90 languages, including Spanish, English, Portuguese, French, and German with very high accuracy.
faq.a4: Your license includes free reactivation when you switch PCs. Just write to us and we'll free your slot within 24h. Pro and Team plans let you activate on more than one device from the start.
faq.a5: The first year includes all updates. After that, you can keep using the version you bought forever, or renew at a low cost for major new features.
faq.q6: Does it work with Google Meet, Zoom and Teams?
faq.a6: With all of them and any other app. Helpmeet captures system audio and your microphone at the OS level — it doesn't depend on official integrations that could block you.
faq.a7: 14 full days, no questions asked. If for any reason Helpmeet doesn't work as expected on your PC, we'll refund 100% of your money.
faq.a8: Yes. Write to us at team+helpmeet@mimotech.vip and we'll send you the portable version. No installation required, just unzip and run. Ideal for corporate teams with installation restrictions.
